topicTitle: Cell-ACDC and SpotMAX — microscopy segmentation, tracking, and spot analysis
courseLine: Official docs · beginner workflows to advanced models, AI spots, and HPC

prompts.title: Cell-ACDC first run: environments, launching `acdc`, and the main menu
prompts.query: I am new to Cell-ACDC. Walk me through installing it (conda vs pip), activating the environment, running `acdc` or `cellacdc`, and what each main-menu module is for (create data structure, data prep, segmentation, GUI). Mention where to look if the window seems frozen.

prompts.title: From raw microscopy files to Cell-ACDC folder layout
prompts.query: Explain how to use Cell-ACDC module 0 to build the experiment/position/Images folder structure from vendor files. Cover Bio-Formats vs AICSImageIO, metadata review, RAM considerations, and the macOS limitation with python-bioformats plus the Fiji macro workaround.

prompts.title: Data prep in Cell-ACDC: z-slice or projection, alignment, crops, and background ROIs
prompts.query: Teach the Cell-ACDC data-prep module for timelapse and z-stacks: choosing a sharp z-slice or projection, frame alignment with phase cross-correlation, defining analysis and background ROIs, optional z-cropping, and how background ROIs flow into later CSV measurements.

prompts.title: Running automated segmentation and tracking in Cell-ACDC
prompts.query: Describe the segmentation module workflow: pick position folder and segmentation channel, choose a segmentation model and parameters, optional stop frame, pick a tracker, and what to expect while processing. Link concepts to when I should re-open the GUI for corrections.

prompts.title: GUI mode: fixing masks, IDs, merges, splits, and repeat tracking
prompts.query: I have Cell-ACDC outputs with tracking or mask errors. Explain viewer vs segmentation/tracking mode, key tools (eraser, brush, separation, edit ID, merge IDs), repeat segmentation/tracking, excluding cells or border objects, and keyboard shortcuts that speed up curation.

prompts.title: Yeast-style cell cycle annotation: mother–bud pairing and reinitialization
prompts.query: How do I use Cell-ACDC cell cycle analysis mode after masks are clean? Cover assign bud to mother, unknown history, reinitialize cell cycle annotation forward, breaking/rebinding pairs after division, and why starting from the first frame is usually recommended.

prompts.title: Choosing segmentation models and trackers for difficult movies
prompts.query: Compare major Cell-ACDC segmentation backends and when each tends to work (e.g., crowded yeast, nuclei in tissue, 3D). Then explain tracker choice and post-processing levers I should tune before giving up on automation.

prompts.title: Integrating a custom segmentation model into Cell-ACDC
prompts.query: I trained my own model elsewhere. Outline the steps and interfaces Cell-ACDC expects to register a new segmentation model, how parameters surface in the UI, and how to validate it on a few frames before a full run.

prompts.title: Bidirectional scanning artifacts and Cell-ACDC shift-correction scripts
prompts.query: My confocal line-scan data shows alternating row offsets from bidirectional scanning. How does Cell-ACDC approach correction, when should I apply it relative to data prep/segmentation, and what sanity checks confirm the fix worked?

prompts.title: Installing SpotMAX: stable vs latest, HPC, and GPU-enabled PyTorch on Linux
prompts.query: Compare installing SpotMAX stable vs latest vs from source. When is the HPC path appropriate, and how should I think about CUDA/PyTorch versions on a Linux workstation versus a cluster headless node?

prompts.title: SpotMAX recommended workflow: GUI setup, CLI batch, and Python API
prompts.query: Describe SpotMAX’s recommended analysis workflow from configuring parameters in the GUI to rerunning headlessly on a server, including when to use the CLI versus importing pipeline functions in a notebook.

prompts.title: How SpotMAX works: reference segmentation, spot prediction, detection, quantification
prompts.query: Explain SpotMAX’s pipeline stages—reference channel segmentation, spot prediction, detection, and quantification—and how outputs relate to tables and masks. Use intuition for smFISH-like puncta plus organelle reference channels.

prompts.title: Tuning SpotMAX when SNR is low or spots are dense and touching
prompts.query: My spots are dim and crowded or frequently merge in the preview. Which SpotMAX parameter groups should I adjust first, how do AI-related parameters differ from classical thresholds, and what iterative strategy avoids overfitting to one field of view?

prompts.title: Training SpotMAX AI and using learned models responsibly
prompts.query: Outline how SpotMAX AI training is set up: data requirements, augmentation pitfalls, judging generalization across positions, and how to document model version and parameters for a paper supplement.

prompts.title: Worked-style goals: smFISH counting and mitochondrial DNA plus network quantification
prompts.query: Summarize goals, inputs, and evaluation metrics for SpotMAX tutorials aimed at smFISH in yeast and joint mtDNA puncta with mitochondrial network segmentation, including how I would sanity-check counts against manual ground truth on a subset.

prompts.title: Community support, citing Cell-ACDC and SpotMAX, and reproducible methods text
prompts.query: Draft a methods paragraph skeleton that mentions Cell-ACDC for cell segmentation/tracking/cell-cycle curation and SpotMAX for puncta or organelle quantification, including version pins, key parameters, and correct citations plus where to ask questions (Image.sc forum, GitHub).
